cc:Work.dc:description: Joint-system replay of all 165 source rows and 241 phase pairs. The first panel compares calculated material curves, with the source curve as its baseline; its lower panel is a curve difference, not an experimental fit residual. The following two panels show the actual co-compression equality constraint and Equation (3) residuals; summing the squared normalized residuals reproduces the stored joint objective. No independent P–V observations are invented. The MgO anchor, source row order and fixed/free K0 mode are unchanged. Missing run AN012, source covariance and original unrounded inputs remain unresolved.
